method: TypeScript AST static literal/marker inventory and glob selection only; no test/runtime coverage measurement
boundaries: Literal calls are not expanded parameterized/runtime test counts
Skip/runIf markers are not actual skipped results; env flags list names only
Filesystem reading marker can mean fixtures or static contract checks, not a quality verdict

Existing archived full-suite failure/blockers are not rerun or replaced by this inventory
